intro: Ride to Ironforge is an introductory courier quest that sends newly trained adventurers on their first gryphon flight from Thelsamar in Loch Modan into the dwarven capital. Entrusted with a list of top mining students from Brock Stoneseeker, the traveler carries the dispatch straight to Golnir Bouldertoe at the Great Forge.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: For just a few coins, one of my gryphons will take you to Ironforge. From there, deliver Brock's list to Golnir Bouldertoe. You'll find him in the Deep Mountain Mining Guild. That's in the Great Forge District of Ironforge, which is right where my gryphon will drop you off!
Speak to me again when you're ready for the journey.

clips.title: Progress
paras: What can I do for you, friend?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ah, the lastest list of Brock's best pupils. I have a batch of honorary picks ready to go. I just need to chisel in the names of the students...
